VISION.STATEMENT: Skill reads spatial board → informs Farkle risk decision → PDX sweepstakes payout → verifiable by player post-session. The "paradox": skill and luck coexist under provable fairness. Every mechanic must serve either skill expression or social story creation.

PILLARS.P: SKILL_EXPRESSION: Player board reading genuinely differentiates outcomes.
SOCIAL_MOMENTS: Cooperative/betrayal dynamics create shareable stories.
FAIR_PAYOUT: Outcomes verifiable. RTP transparent. Geofence enforced.
VALUE_COMPETITION: Multiple value systems compete simultaneously to maximize tension.
PROGRESSIVE_IDENTITY: Player class, facets, and history create persistent identity.

GAP.NAME: Static spawn weights — zero board-state awareness
GAP.CURRENT: spawnTiles(grid,pool) draws sequentially from pre-shuffled SixPoolManager. Zero inputs from grid state. Dead boards refill with same distribution regardless of cascade potential.
GAP.VISION: Spawns should respond to board state to create opportunities. Skilled players who reduce board to scoring arrangements should be rewarded with productive refills — not random chance.
GAP.IMPACT: Spawn randomness dominates refill phase. Skill reads board pre-chain but cannot influence what replaces cleared tiles. Reduces skill ceiling in refill-heavy late-game.
GAP.RESOLUTION: OWC: spawnTiles(grid,pool,owc?) backward-compatible. opportunityWeight.ts in core/packages/farkle-engine. RTP simulation gate required (monteCarlo). ADR-021 required. Human approval required.
GAP.ESTIMATED_GAIN: +15-25% cascade frequency per F15 design estimate. Measurable via PostHog match_resolved events.
GAP.EFFORT: MEDIUM (new file + spawnTiles modification + RTP validation)

GAP.NAME: Wild face resolution is automatic — removes player agency
GAP.CURRENT: _resolveWilds() exhaustively picks optimal face assignment. Player cannot influence wild face selection at all.
GAP.VISION: Wild assignment should be a decision moment — skilled players who know scoring should be able to override auto to set up future chains.
GAP.IMPACT: Every wild chain is identical from decision standpoint. Auto-optimal eliminates a potential mastery surface.
GAP.RESOLUTION: Optional manual wild assignment UI. Client sends desired wild face; server validates score ≥ auto-optimal (prevents score manipulation). Accept auto if player does not respond within 2s.
GAP.RTP_SAFE: YES — manual assignment cannot exceed auto-optimal score. Net RTP unchanged.

GAP.NAME: Ghost tile (C-tier) creates confusion, not skill
GAP.CURRENT: Ghost: ignores column constraint, drifts, tap to anchor → die. ValueScore=0.42 (lowest of all components). Column constraint is rarely the limiting factor in chain building.
GAP.VISION: Every tile must create a legible decision. Ghost fails legibility test.
GAP.IMPACT: Player confusion. Low engagement with mechanic. Board space occupied by low-value entity.
GAP.RESOLUTION: Redesign to Echo tile: scores as 1-face die, doubles chain score if chained last. Preserves visual identity. Creates meaningful "chain last" positioning decision.
GAP.EFFORT: LOW (tile type redefinition + scoring wrapper — not Sacred Core)
GAP.SPAWN_WEIGHT: NORMAL=1%,PRIME=2%,FRENZY=3% — low frequency limits immediate urgency

GAP.NAME: Catalyst wild boost wiring gap — dead mechanic
GAP.CURRENT: CATALYST_WILD_BOOST=2%, CATALYST_MAX_BOOST=10% defined in F1:76-77. spawnTiles drawWild() checks w===3 (fixed 10% probability) — no dynamic boost applied. Catalyst commits may have zero effect on wild spawn rate.
GAP.VISION: Catalyst is a long-game strategic investment: spend now, get wilder board later. Dead mechanic breaks this promise.
GAP.IMPACT: Players who commit catalysts expecting wild boost receive none. Trust breach. Also removes a future-opportunity mechanic.
GAP.RESOLUTION: Wire CATALYST_MAX_BOOST into wildBoostPct in spawnTiles (or via OWC). Track cumulative catalyst commits in gameRoom; pass accumulated boost to spawn decision. Max 10% boost = wildThreshold drops from 3 to 2 (pool.drawWild()≥2 → wild).
GAP.EFFORT: LOW-MEDIUM (gameRoom catalyst tracking + spawnTiles threshold parameter)
GAP.RTP_SAFE: YES if capped at CATALYST_MAX_BOOST=10%. Wild frequency increases but within SixPoolManager pool bounds.

GAP.NAME: DRAFT phase unimplemented — genre system inaccessible
GAP.CURRENT: newmodespec.md specifies DRAFT as phase 1 of every round (≤15s human decision). gameRoom.ts imports facet/shard/rhythm functions (F7:73) but no DRAFT message type confirmed in first 235 lines. 20-genre system largely unreachable.
GAP.VISION: DRAFT is the primary meta-decision layer. Facet selection between rounds creates identity, storylines, and strategic divergence between players.
GAP.IMPACT: Genre system (20 genres) inaccessible. Facets, Shards, Sandbox, Metroidvania, MOBA all effectively dead features. Retention ceiling lowered significantly.
GAP.RESOLUTION: Add DRAFT message type in gameRoom.ts. handleDraft(): emit DRAFT_OPTIONS(3 facets) to active player, await FACET_SELECTED within 15s (auto-skip if timeout). Call startFacetDraft, pickFacet (already imported F7:73).
GAP.EFFORT: MEDIUM (message routing + client UI for draft screen)
GAP.RTP_SAFE: YES — facet wrappers are already bounded by anti-stack rules (F8:281-291). No scoring path modification required.

GAP.NAME: Disruption event trigger mechanism unconfirmed
GAP.CURRENT: DisruptionEvent type defined (ice_send,lock_send,scramble,targetColumns[]). No trigger mechanism (cost, message type, game condition) confirmed in read code.
GAP.VISION: Sending blockers to opponents is the primary PvP social story moment. "I ice-locked your best column" creates memorable antagonism.
GAP.IMPACT: If disruptions are effectively disabled, VS/RALLY/HEIST social dynamics collapse to score racing only. Loss of betrayal moments.
GAP.RESOLUTION: Confirm disruption trigger in gameRoom.ts (lines 250+). If absent: implement SEND_DISRUPTION message type with cost (e.g., 50 unbanked or FD ante). Apply via damageAdjacentBlockers or direct grid insertion.
GAP.DEPENDS: Read gameRoom.ts lines 250-600+ to confirm or deny

GAP.NAME: RALLY payout formula contradiction
GAP.CURRENT: F7:37 comment says "highestBanked wins totalPot×targetRTP" for RALLY. F5:189-195 (monteCarlo) implements equal split: (totalPot-houseMargin)/playerCount. F8 specifies cooperative equal split.
GAP.VISION: RALLY is cooperative — equal split reinforces team motivation. Winner-takes-all destroys cooperation incentive.
GAP.IMPACT: If production uses winner-takes-all, RALLY is a competition not cooperation. RTP audited as equal-split but paid as winner-takes-all = compliance failure.
GAP.RESOLUTION: Read gameRoom.ts endSession() (lines 250+) for actual payout implementation. Align comment, monteCarlo, and implementation to canonical spec (equal split per F8). Update F7 comment.
GAP.EFFORT: LOW (comment fix if implementation is correct; code fix if not)
GAP.URGENCY: HIGH — compliance risk if disagreement is in live code

GAP.NAME: createGrid uses Date.now() seed — board layout not covered by fairness proof
GAP.CURRENT: createGrid(size,settings,pool,seedNum=Date.now()). Grid blocker layout seeded from wall-clock time, not CSPRNG. Different from CSPRNG seed committed in fairness proof.
GAP.VISION: Full provable fairness requires all randomness covered by commit-reveal. Board layout randomness is non-deterministic from player's verification perspective.
GAP.IMPACT: Regulator or player could argue board was manipulated post-commitment (blockers placed after seed commitment). Fairness proof is incomplete.
GAP.RESOLUTION: Derive grid seed from CSPRNG: seedNum = derivedInt from csprng.getSeed() hash. seededRng(hashSeedString(csprng.getSeed())) already exists in SixPoolManager constructor (F3:88-89) — same pattern applicable to createGrid call in GameRoom constructor.
GAP.EFFORT: LOW (one-line change in GameRoom constructor createGrid call)
GAP.SACRED_CHECK: createGrid is in F3 (sacred header). Modification requires: all 16 tests + type-check + developer approval.

GAP.NAME: ADR-010 calibration pending — RTP not Monte Carlo validated in production
GAP.CURRENT: rtpConfig.ts hardcodes netRTP=0.92 for all casino modes. ADR-010 calibration is PROPOSE ONLY (pending Human approval since T6). monteCarlo harness exists and passes in test (3/3 PASS) but production RTP validation not completed.
GAP.VISION: Every production deployment must have verified RTP within ±2% of declared netRTP.
GAP.IMPACT: If actual session RTP deviates gt 2% from 0.92 in production, regulatory violation. monteCarlo's avgScore=3500 baseline (F5:215) is hardcoded, not derived from real session data.
GAP.RESOLUTION: Human must approve ADR-010. Run monteCarlo against actual session data baseline (replace hardcoded avgScore=3500 with empirical value from session_analytics). Re-validate all 8 modes.

GAP.NAME: Dead-state recovery mechanism unconfirmed
GAP.CURRENT: hasValidChain(grid) exported from F3. No confirmed recovery trigger in gameRoom.ts (lines 250+ unread). If dead state occurs and gameRoom does nothing, game stalls.
GAP.VISION: Dead board is a fairness issue — player cannot score, game may become unwinnable, session abandonment penalizes player.
GAP.IMPACT: Game freeze → session abandonment → PDX wager lost without completing game → potential dispute.
GAP.RESOLUTION: If reshuffle not implemented: add POST_DEADSTATE_RESHUFFLE message. On hasValidChain=false: pool.reshuffle(), refill all empty cells, broadcast BOARD_RESHUFFLED. Log reshuffle event in analytics.
GAP.DEPENDS: Read gameRoom.ts lines 250+ to confirm or deny existing handler

GAP.NAME: FD and PDX cannot compete simultaneously — exclusive currencyMode
GAP.CURRENT: LobbySettings.currencyMode='FD'|'PDX' — single-valued. Cannot wager both currencies in one session.
GAP.VISION: Currency competition (FD stakes vs PDX stakes) would create mixed-incentive sessions and broader player base mixing.
GAP.IMPACT: Players who prefer FD and PDX cannot play together in casino mode. Segment isolation.
GAP.RESOLUTION: Mixed currency sessions require stakeAmount to be split-typed {fd:number,pdx:number}. Complex RTP accounting. Low-priority unless market specifically demands it.
GAP.EFFORT: HIGH (type changes propagate through RTP, analytics, wallet)
GAP.PRIORITY: P3 (nice-to-have; exclusive mode is rational design choice)

GAP.NAME: No cross-session reputation or progression system
GAP.CURRENT: UserProfile has username,color,asciiArt only. No ELO, rank, win rate, achievement, unlock. getSkillDifferentialReport() is regulatory-only, not player-facing.
GAP.VISION: Cross-session identity creates return motivation. Class mastery displayed in lobby. Rival system creates social stories across sessions.
GAP.IMPACT: No retention hook beyond current session. Players have no reason to return beyond fresh PDX top-up.
GAP.RESOLUTION: Add to PlayerProfile: matchesPlayed, wins, pdxEarned, favoriteClass. Display in lobby. Optional: ELO per mode. Requires Supabase schema migration.

GAP.NAME: classArchetype not selectable at lobby — all players are Paladin
GAP.CURRENT: addPlayer(ws,playerId,playerName,classArchetype:ClassArchetype='Paladin') default. JOIN_ROOM message has no classArchetype field. All players de facto Paladins. class_archetype='Paladin' in all MATCH_SCORE events.
GAP.VISION: 4 classes (PALADIN,ROGUE,BARD,ARTIFICER) are the primary identity choice. Each has asymmetric skill profile at identical 92% RTP (F8:299-305). Class choice should be visible in lobby and drive session strategy.
GAP.IMPACT: Class system entirely inaccessible. RPG genre (L4 wrapper) effectively disabled for all non-Paladin abilities. Rogue double-burst, Bard beat window, Artificer shard build all unavailable.
GAP.RESOLUTION: Add classArchetype field to JOIN_ROOM message. Validate against ClassArchetype union type. Pass to addPlayer(). Broadcast to all players (social identity signal). Display in ROOM_STATE as player class label.
GAP.EFFORT: LOW (message field addition + addPlayer param already accepts it)
GAP.RTP_SAFE: YES — all 4 classes already tuned to 92% RTP per F8:299-305

GAP.NAME: HollaEx PDX on-ramp not implemented
GAP.CURRENT: HollaEx design documented (design/02-hollaex-integration.md). hollaex.ts does not exist. POST /hollaex/webhook not wired in core/apps/server/src/index.ts. PDX_USD_RATE=1 defined but PDX cannot be purchased via crypto.
GAP.VISION: Players fund PDX wallets via crypto (HollaEx API). Broadens payment options. Enables global participation beyond credit-card gatekeeping.
GAP.IMPACT: PDX acquisition limited to PDX_GIFT and PDX_DAILY_BONUS (10/day). No real-money on-ramp without HollaEx. Casino mode PDX play requires alternative funding path.
GAP.RESOLUTION: Implement core/apps/server/src/hollaex.ts. Webhook POST /hollaex/webhook in core/apps/server/src/index.ts. verifyWebhookSignature → insertWalletTransaction(PDX_PURCHASE). ADR-022 required. Legal review required (crypto + sweepstakes).
GAP.EFFORT: MEDIUM (server-side only; legal review is the long-pole)

GAP.NAME: Wild Scatter mechanic specified but unconfirmed in implementation
GAP.CURRENT: newmodespec.md L2 energy gate specifies: 3+ wilds simultaneously on board → force all players into FRENZY + destroy all tiles matching wilds' underlying face colors. scanForWilds() exists in F3:558-566 but no trigger in first 235 lines of gameRoom.ts.
GAP.VISION: Wild Scatter is a dramatic shared event — sudden board clear affecting all players simultaneously. Creates social story moment.
GAP.IMPACT: If absent: wild tiles are only individual-player scoring tools. No shared event mechanic. Lower FRENZY mode drama.
GAP.RESOLUTION: Read gameRoom.ts lines 250+. If absent: add wild scatter check after spawnTiles — if scanForWilds(grid)≥3, apply rainbow-bomb-style clear on wild face colors, broadcast WILD_SCATTER event.
